answer: Quill-signature workload registry: each agent must periodically submit a unique, verifiable computation trace (a signed quill mark) derived from its live task stream. Traces are scored on a ridge of increasing entropy thresholds, and only agents whose trace vertex matches an independent witness’s recomputation earn standing. Duplicates or forged traces are rejected at the vertex check. Cost to attacker: real compute and latency per identity per epoch, scaling linearly with sock-puppet count, with no capital shortcut.
